items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: And so, he used to do a lot with me and teach me.

ctx.x: part of the family, like a first cousin, Johnny Richardson. He was a bass player. H was supposed to have been, he was rated the best bass player around that part of the country.
And so, he used to do a lot with me and teach me. And also, my first cousin, a brother, he told me, he gave me my first horn.

So, the family, my mother was in the choir in church. Practically, my whole family - my aunts, my uncles - they all sang in the choir. So, when I was, got to be about 9, and playing my horn, I used to go and start playing my horn with them in the choir.
